content.text: Sorry I missed your bug report till just now. Are you able to run the fedora-client integration test for listDatastreams successfully? (mvn test -Dtest=ListDatastreamsTest) You'll need an instance of fedora up and running for this test (the pom for fedora-client lists the defaults it expects, localhost port 8080, etc., but you can change those to fit)
And can you confirm that you're testing against Fedora 3.4?
I followed your instruction and got the same error message as attached. Yes, I'm using Fedora 3.4.

i've tried this against 3.3 and 3.4 (3.4.1 actually, but shouldn't make a difference) and can't duplicate the error. Any ideas about what might be different on your end? You're using the latest version of fedora-client?
I've tried in 0.1.3 and 0.1.4-SNAPSHOT but got the same error. I will try it again once we have our new Fedora 3 server ready.
please re-open if you get more info/details

comments.body:
Frank,

Sorry I missed your bug report till just now. Are you able to run the fedora-client integration test for listDatastreams successfully? (mvn test -Dtest=ListDatastreamsTest) You'll need an instance of fedora up and running for this test (the pom for fedora-client lists the defaults it expects, localhost port 8080, etc., but you can change those to fit)

And can you confirm that you're testing against Fedora 3.4?

Thanks

Hi Edwin,

I followed your instruction and got the same error message as attached. Yes, I'm using Fedora 3.4.

Thanks,

Frank

i've tried this against 3.3 and 3.4 (3.4.1 actually, but shouldn't make a difference) and can't duplicate the error. Any ideas about what might be different on your end? You're using the latest version of fedora-client?
I've tried in 0.1.3 and 0.1.4-SNAPSHOT but got the same error. I will try it again once we have our new Fedora 3 server ready.
please re-open if you get more info/details

...
ListDatastreamsResponse response = listDatastreams("york:3").execute(client);
for(DatastreamType dst: response.getDatastreams()) {
System.out.println(dst.getDsid());
}

Thanks,

Frank
Digital Library Systems Developer
The University of York

------------------------------------------------------
